sources.methodology: One serial Harbor Terminus-2 attempt per task on the exact pinned task set; verifier-backed rewards, complete task wall time, and recorded complete-request token accounting were normalized from the prompt-free summary. Exact token-demand signals are emitted only when the harness reports no incomplete API request.
